summary: Our two seats (Armada at F3, Cortex at H3, Sonnet 5.5 players under an Opus 5.5 commander) lost by surrender at 18:40 to thebluegecko (Cortex, from B7) on Isidis Crack. Both seats expanded on two constructors each until 4:51 and called their first raiders home by 3:51, while his lone Grunts took 14 extractors before 8:00 and he set Exploiters and a Guard on the middle; seat 1 went in alone at 6:04 and ground about even before walking back at 8:08. The commander's 8:11 gather-and-go-together direction turned seat 0's 20 Maces (already on fight_to spot_46) into a wait at 9:07, and from 9:15 to 10:10 both bodies stood about 850 apart at F4 while neither went; his raiders then took 12 extractors in both bases (24 to 13) and three more push directions (10:11, 12:11, 14:11) went unexecuted. His Brute, Thug and Pounder push into both bases at 13:06-14:33 traded about even, and three Whirlwind bombers took ten extractors from 14:14, seat 1's first anti-air bot standing at 14:13 and seat 0's only at 17:15. No unit of ours came within 1,500 of his start and his base was never seen; we ended on 6 to 9 extractors.

Grunts from 2:35 (112 distinct seen), singly and in small parties at our outer extractors from 3:13: 14 extractors by 7:35, none of the parties paying in the raid ledger. Two Exploiters (armed extractors) and a Guard on the middle spots by 6:05-6:13 and a radar at 7:52, which stopped seat 1's lone push. A vehicle plant by 7:42 (14 Pounders, 14 Incisors seen); stealthy Graverobbers raising our dead Pawns (raised armpw in his parties from 8:13, Graverobbers first seen 10:44). Raids into both bases at 10:11-11:16 while our bodies waited at F4; a Hercules transport at 10:51; Brutes from 12:01 and Thugs from 12:22 for a push into both bases at 13:06-14:33 that traded about even; three Whirlwind bombers from 12:57 that took ten extractors at the back of our bases; a Twin Guard at 15:32. He fought only in our half after 8:30, and his base, plants and economy were never seen; by the review's count he had spent at least 15,491 metal on what we saw by 13:12, and no tier-2 unit of his was seen.

bears_on.note: Both seats called the first raiders home by 3:51; no unit of ours came within 1,500 of his start and his base was never seen, while his raids and greedy middle ran unanswered.
Lost on extractors: 24 at 10:00 to 6-9 at the end, the expansion slow from the opening (the user: 'Sonnet does not expand as Opus did'); the army trade was about even.
He held the middle with Exploiters and a Guard from 6:13; our two seats never held half the map nor raided his corners.
Seat 1 alone at 6:04-8:08 ground even; at 9:15-10:10 the two bodies stood 850 apart waiting for each other; three joint pushes never left together.
The commander's '3.6 to 1' at 10:11 was against a seen floor (no truth file); the lead, real or not, was spent waiting in our half until his raids recalled it.

Its rider 'Maces as the first units of the game are wrong; Grunts kill Maces early': seat 0 went Maces only at 3:31 and the slow bodies could neither catch his Grunts and Incisors nor protect the spots.
Wrecks worth about 10,000 metal lay beside our bases at the end and his Graverobbers raised our Pawns; reclaim ordered by the commander from 12:11 was not done at scale.
From the other side: he answered our massed line bots with Pounders by 7:42 and Brutes by 12:01, and a bomber switch (cf. 'air switch to bomb solar') once our bodies sat at home.

lens.caveats: No truth file: every number of his (army, the WINDOWS ratios, the commander's '3.6 to 1') is a floor of what we saw, and his economy is unknown. The per-match tools read record-0 only; seat 1 was read through a scratchpad directory of links (record-1 as record-0). pro_baseline.py not run (Comet only; Isidis has no cards); impedance_sweep.py and commander_turns --told not run. No results.jsonl or batch.json. I differ from the existing review in ranking: it roots the game at 9:15 (the bodies waiting at F4) with expansion second; I root it in the opening (0:41-3:51: slow expansion and the first handful recalled), on the user's expansion remark and L-raid-first-handful, and treat 8:11-10:10 as the costliest consequence, itself rooted in the commander's 8:11 direction that stopped seat 0's 20 Maces already going. The trade line is my sum of the two seats' analyze_match losses.
